Tome todas as peças do adversário ou dei:
Capture all of your opponent's pieces or leave them with no moves.

American checkers rules: Black moves first; a man moves and jumps only forward, diagonally, one square at a time. Jumping is mandatory, and a man that jumps keeps jumping while it can. A man that reaches the last row becomes a king (and the move ends there); a king moves and jumps one square, forward and backward.

Click a piece and then the destination square (or drag it); for a jump with more than one path, click the squares one by one. The game is a draw after 40 moves in a row with only kings and no jumps, or when the same position comes up three times.

Capture all of your opponent's pieces or leave them with no moves.

Brazilian draughts rules: White moves first; a man moves one square forward, diagonally, and captures forward and backward. Capturing is mandatory, and you must capture the largest number of pieces (the pieces that must capture are marked). A man that ends its move on the last row becomes a king; a king moves any number of squares diagonally and captures from a distance.

Click a piece and then the destination square (or drag it); for a capture with more than one path, click the squares one by one. The game is a draw after 20 moves in a row with only kings and no captures, or when the same position comes up three times.

O Mac Plus é o PCE.js, um emulador do Ma:
Mac Plus is PCE.js, an emulator of the Macintosh of the time, with its black and white screen. Nothing from Apple comes with Retro Computer: put in the C:\Mac folder of the disk the ROM image of your Mac (a .rom file, 128 KB for the Mac Plus, 256 KB for the Mac SE or 512 KB for the Mac Classic), the System floppy (System 6 or 7) and the floppies of your games, such as SimAnt (.dsk, .img or .image, from Disk Copy 4.2).

The disk with System or Boot in its name goes into the first drive, and the Mac starts from it; the others go into the next drives (up to three floppies and three hard disks). Double-clicking a Mac disk also opens it here.

What the Mac writes goes back to the disk when you close the window (or with File › Save to Disk); the version from before the Mac was started is kept.

Click the screen so the Mac gets the keys and the mouse. The Alt key works as Command, and Ctrl as Option. Everything works without the internet.

PCE.js is by James Friend, based on PCE by Hampa Hug (GPL-2.0); see ATRIBUICOES.md.

Retro Computer brings nothing from Apple: put in the C:\Mac folder the ROM image of your Mac (a .rom file, 128 KB for the Mac Plus, 256 KB for the Mac SE or 512 KB for the Mac Classic), the System floppy and the floppies of your games (.dsk, .img or .image).

Leve o rei do adversário ao xeque-mate::
Checkmate the opponent's king: attacked and with nowhere to escape.

Click a piece and then the destination square (or drag the piece). The dots show the possible moves; the last move is marked in yellow, and a king in check, in red. The arrow keys and Enter also play.

To castle, move the king two squares toward the rook. A pawn that reaches the last rank becomes the piece you choose.

The game is a draw by stalemate (the side to move is not in check and has no move), when the same position comes up three times, after 50 moves without a capture or a pawn move, and when there is not enough material left to checkmate.

Game › Undo (Ctrl+Z) takes back your last move. The game is saved: closing the window does not lose it.
